messages:
Aisha (Sales): FYI — HarvestPay just escalated. After last week's model rollout they're seeing p95 on chat generate jump from ~700ms to ~1.8s for 128-token flows. One customer timed out a webhook. Filing it here for triage.

Tom (Product): Thanks. Do we have customer request IDs or sample payloads? Which model/pool are they pinned to?

Aisha (Sales): They attached a sample request and a trace id. Excerpt:
```
request_id: hp-20260319-88
model: redwood-4b-emu
pool: dedicated-west-1-3
prompt_tokens: 120
observed_p95: 1800ms
```
They say it started ~2026-03-19T11:02Z after the 'q3' quantization rollout for dedicated pools.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout completed: rollout_id=rl-20260318-77, config: {quant_profile: "q3", batching: "adaptive", kv_cache: "enabled"}

Diego (eng-runtime): Marking. Initial suspicion: quant path + adaptive batching interplay. q3 introduced a slower kernel path on sequence lengths around 100-150 in our perf tests. Can you share the perf traces? Maya, can you pick this up as oncall?

Maya (oncall): Taking. Link to trace: https://internal.redwood/pulse/trace/HP-ABC123
Quick notes from trace: increased GPU memcpy stalls at step ~6, and batch sizes spiking to 18 for short prompts due to adaptive batching config. p95 correlates with big batches + quant kernel overhead.

Diego (eng-runtime): Confirmed from trace — latency tail tied to transient batching combining many short requests. Options: 1) revert quant_profile to previous (q2) for that dedicated pool, 2) adjust adaptive batching thresholds for short sequences, or 3) add a fast-path quant kernel (longer dev effort).

Tom (Product): What's the customer impact classification? Sales says timeouts and degraded UX — looks like P1 for affected customers. Recommend short-term rollback for that pool + mid-term QOL change to launch criteria.

Aisha (Sales): HarvestPay is asking for an ETA. They want mitigation within the day if possible.

Maya (oncall): I can run the rollback for dedicated-west-1-3 now (disable q3). Will open an incident and coordinate with Diego on rollback validation. ETA ~45m.

Diego (eng-runtime): I'll prep the PR to add a per-pool flag to opt out of q3 and a quick perf test script. Also will add a guard in the rollout job to require baseline p50/p95 comparison for the same seqlen distribution.

Tom (Product): Actions recorded: - Maya: incident + rollback (owner) - Diego: PR to opt-out q3 + perf script (owner) - Tom: create backlog ticket and add new launch criteria "perf baseline verification (p50/p95 within 5% of current) for seqlen buckets" - Aisha: communicate ETA to HarvestPay.

Aisha (Sales): Communicated ETA, they appreciate quick action. Asking to be notified when rollback completes so they can retest.

Maya (oncall): Rollback applied to dedicated-west-1-3. Post-rollback p95 back to ~720ms on sampled requests. Closing incident once HarvestPay confirms. :thumbsup:

Tom (Product): Follow-ups for roadmap: - Add perf-gate to Dedicated rollouts (blocking for customer-impacting pools). - Add small-batch threshold tuning to Optimize recommendations. - Evaluate adding synthetic customer workloads for seqlen 80-160 in canaries.

Diego (eng-runtime): Filing PR and CI perf job now. Will tag product and support for validation.

Aisha (Sales): Thanks everyone. Please add the HarvestPay contact to the validation loop so they can confirm before we re-enable q3.

Tom (Product): Agreed — new acceptance criteria on model rollout: must include customer-traffic-matched canary and explicit p50/p95 diff check. Adding to backlog and marking high priority for next sprint. :white_check_mark:
